fullTextZH: 如果你没有来过巴厘岛，
fullTextEN: If you haven't been to Bali,

fullTextZH: 今天我和你一起去散步。
fullTextEN: Today I will go for a walk with you.

fullTextZH: 今天我们要找四个东西。
fullTextEN: Today we are looking for four things.
Now there is a house behind me.
But it's not an old house.

fullTextZH: 这些房子都不是老房子。
fullTextEN: These houses are not old houses.
I really like taking walks here.

fullTextZH: 所以我每天都在这里散步。
fullTextEN: So I take a walk here every day.

fullTextZH: 在巴厘岛有很多漂亮的花。
fullTextEN: There are many beautiful flowers in Bali.
There are many, many coconuts here.
There are also many coconuts here.
There are two kinds of coconuts.
The green coconut is very big,
But they smile when they see you.
Because they really like to smile.

fullTextZH: 现在我走了差不多十分钟。
fullTextEN: Now I have walked for about ten minutes.

fullTextZH: 这里有很多很多小鸭子。
fullTextEN: There are many, many ducklings here.
Now we are going to find frangipani.
This tree is not very tall.

fullTextZH: 椰子树可以长得很高很高。
fullTextEN: Coconut trees can grow very, very tall.

fullTextZH: 为什么这个叫鸡蛋花呢？
鸡蛋也是白色和黄色的，
fullTextEN: Eggs are also white and yellow,
We still need to find the old house.

fullTextZH: 小牛，你知道老房子在哪吗？
fullTextEN: Little Niu, do you know where the old house is?
These old houses are really old,

fullTextZH: 我觉得这些老房子像画，
fullTextEN: I think these old houses are like paintings,

fullTextZH: 我每次看这些老房子，我要看很长时间。
fullTextEN: Every time I look at these old houses, I want to look for a long time.

fullTextZH: 我觉得这些老房子很特别。
fullTextEN: I think these old houses are very special.

fullTextZH: 然后你听懂了我的中文，对不对？
fullTextEN: Then you understood my Chinese, right?

fullTextZH: 现在我要回家了，下次见！
fullTextEN: Now I have to go home, see you next time!
